semantics: These are company-reported annual electricity-consumption figures for individual Meta data-center facilities. They are aggregate annual observations, not interval meter telemetry, and are kept separate from queue MW and Epoch IT-power estimates.

source.source_name: Meta 2024 Responsible Business Practices Report — Data Index
source.assurance_note: Meta states that the report's data and metrics are non-audited estimates unless otherwise noted.

records.basis: Meta's report lists Eagle Mountain (UT) at 787,740 MWh of electricity consumption for 2023. This is an annual facility consumption figure, not an interval demand series.
